The entire dirty-package collection and save block is gated on ImportedAssets.Num() > 0. If the FBX import builds meshes and DDC entries but yields zero UObject assets, nothing is marked dirty, nothing is saved, bImportAndSaveSucceeded is left true, and exit code is 0. This is the mechanism that permits hours of CPU work with zero persisted packages.
Assignment rather than accumulation, so each loop iteration overwrites the flag set by the previous iteration's import/save outcome. Final reported state reflects only the last group plus LoadLevel.
